cohort: 150 women who underwent caesarean section and 300 women who had vaginal delivery at Bolgatanga Regional Hospital in Ghana
finding: Increased odds of caesarean section were associated with attending antenatal care four or more times, referral from another health facility, and fetal weight >= 4000 grams.
gest_age: Included gestational ages > 40 weeks and < 37 weeks
birth_weight: Included fetal weights >= 4000 grams and 1500-2499 grams
